user.title: Set up Unclouded
user.description: Unclouded shows which parts of your Home Assistant need the internet. It only reads, it never changes anything.

important_fails.title: {name} stops without internet
important_fails.description: The automation **{name}**, which you marked as important, does nothing while the internet is down. Open Unclouded in the sidebar to see which parts need it.

important_degraded.title: {name} works only partly without internet
important_degraded.description: The automation **{name}**, which you marked as important, runs while the internet is down, but some of its parts do not get through. Open Unclouded in the sidebar to see which ones.

important_notifications.title: Notifications of {name} need the internet
important_notifications.description: The automation **{name}**, which you marked as important, sends notifications that do not arrive while the internet is down. Everything else it does keeps working.

now_cloud.title: {title} now needs the internet
now_cloud.description: **{title}** ({domain}) now connects through a cloud service, usually after an update. Until now it worked without the internet. Open Unclouded in the sidebar to see which automations are affected.

confirm.title: {title} now needs the internet
confirm.description: **{title}** ({domain}) now connects through a cloud service. Confirm that you have seen this; Unclouded only reports it again if it changes once more.

now_partial.title: {title} now works only partly without internet
now_partial.description: **{title}** ({domain}) now needs the internet in some situations, usually after an update. Until now it worked without it. Open Unclouded in the sidebar to see which automations are affected.

confirm.title: {title} now works only partly without internet
confirm.description: **{title}** ({domain}) now needs the internet in some situations. Confirm that you have seen this; Unclouded only reports it again if it changes once more.
